notes:
The neutral description is broad, but replication p. 6 uniquely presents Figure 1 for criminal intentionality, so the paired original result is d = 0.76, not the distinct Mind Attribution Scale result d = 0.66. Original publication is 2011 (online December 2010), consistent with the supplied DOI. Replication Figure 1 prints −0.24 [−0.50, 0.02]; adjacent prose instead gives an opposite-direction difference of 0.24 and CI −0.49 to 0.03. Figure values retained as printed. No p value for the pooled target mean difference is printed in the located result; the p = .045 nearby tests heterogeneity and is not the target effect test. No conversions or pooled participant-N sums performed. Both primary PDF titles and DOIs verified. Sources acquired from original-author and replication-author websites after publisher DOI landing pages returned 403; no challenge retries or paid routes used.
Completion source review (n_r): Explicit final Total included counts for mutually exclusive randomized conditions in the 11 named independent laboratory studies. Original and MTurk not included in meta-analysis.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Page-6 locator identifies Figure 1 criminal intentionality. Caption explicitly identifies raw mean difference. Preserve signed pooled estimate; slight prose/figure CI discrepancy retained in notes.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors state no evidence for greater perceived intentionality; failed records this narrative verdict.
